name: hxn-gpu-webgl2
description: WebGL2 for Haxe in the browser, on hxcpp and Ash compiled to wasm: buffers, textures, samplers, programs, vertex arrays and framebuffers
releasenote: Moves to the hxn.gpu.webgl2 package, on hxn 0.3.5. Under Ash, the context draws offscreen on a canvas of its own when another agent holds the web page's, and a command that throws or a browser agent that fails ends the web page with the reason.
